slice: P2 selected MLINESTYLE source-only dependency grammar
scope: A private, bounded source-only classifier over the accepted whole-read scalar capture. The selected AC1027 profile recognizes HEADER, selected LTYPE/LAYER/BLOCK_RECORD tables, BLOCK/ENDBLK, ordinary selected LINE/MLINE, and a rooted DICTIONARY/MLINESTYLE graph. Source/target encodings are ASCII and binary. It is not called by export and does not enable consumed-style geometry.

contract.authority: The private caller checks the completed same-read observer owner, data/container identity and generation, source version, read context and outcome, then authenticates the original root structural record and its unique ACAD_MLINESTYLE soft-owner target before invoking the bounded classifier. The source root, dictionary entries, style owners/reactors and observed 340 references are checked again against that original graph.
contract.grammar: The selected grammar requires its exact section, record, subclass and field ordering and rejects unknown sections, CLASSES, unsupported fields, application scopes other than the selected structural reactor, XDATA, embedded/proxy/binary payloads and unqualified reference roles. These are selected admission restrictions, not claims that every refused DXF is invalid. TABLE group 70 is treated as a maximum. BLOCK flags and xref path are restricted to a local non-xref profile.
contract.nameBinding: Each admitted MLINE group 2 and MLINESTYLE group 2 must have exact ASCII spelling matching the unique source MLINESTYLE dictionary key associated with the observed 340/350 target. Duplicate source names/keys are rejected under ASCII case folding. Exact spelling and the specific *Model_Space spelling are conservative profile restrictions, not general collation or DXF validity claims. The earlier intentionally stale-name witness refuses.
contract.flagsAndValues: MLINESTYLE group 70 permits only documented bits 1, 2, 16, 32, 64, 256, 512 and 1024. Unrecognized bits refuse. MLINE group-2 names are restricted to 32 ASCII bytes; style descriptions to 255 source bytes, conservative bounds for this profile. Documented style flags passing this source classifier do not qualify fill, caps, rendering or geometry.
contract.bounds: Default limits are 4096 captured fields, 64 nodes, 256 KiB source retained peak, and 256 MiB logical work; at most 16 dictionary entries per node and 2–32 vertices with two elements are admitted. The checked precharge includes 512 times the retained source peak for byte-sensitive comparisons, field work, fixed bounded graph-pair work and the root lookup. Node[64] and its entry arrays are fixed stack storage, separate from the retained-source cap. Logical charges are not an exact RSS or CPU-time ceiling.
contract.limits: The result is SourceCandidate, not write eligibility. The tests deliberately show that modifying a live dictionary or removing live entities can leave SourceCandidate unchanged. Complete live/removed/new/proxy consumer and dependency census, late-mutation checks, output inspection, geometry, native validity and native rendering remain open. No support claim is promoted.

validation.inventory: Canonical/source-release inventory check passed for 627 tracked files.
validation.focusedControls: 14 source candidates, 48 classified refusals, four missing-authority refusals, 14 exact/one-below quota sets, 52 same-adapter corrected retries and four callback-spoof controls across ASCII/binary. Cases include remapped handles, renamed symbols, ordinary and multiple LINEs, ignored comment, stale and mismatched names, hidden application 340, unknown field, XDATA, wrong owner/target/reactor, missing LTYPE, ambiguous block names, undersized table maximum, xref BLOCK, proxy, unknown section, unknown flag bits, and overlong style description/MLINE name.

finalSharedProbe.meaning: A separate physical tag decoder checked six source associations; classification-record hashes are diagnostics, not emitted DXF, independent native validation or a geometry proof.

fixtures: All generated source drawings, physical projections and probes remain in ignored local scratch; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
